name: 15801 · Dubois, PA
findings: ZIP 15801 (Dubois) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15801 (Dubois) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
